author: Tazz
body:
Here is the tiebreaker for the tournament. There is one wool on this map - in the middle. This has to be played in Bo3 to get the fairest results.

Authors:
  • Tazz
  • Bootey (eric)
  • Jiveh
Contributors:
  • BmB
  • Matoma
  • Fouled


UPDATE: The plan was to have one wool in the map, but that is not possible. Each team has a wool in the middle, and they need to get the others teams. They are one block away from eachother. http://imgur.com/F3APivv

Blue VS Red - Fighting for wools in the middle of the map.

  • Download: Private
  • YML: http://pastebin.com/6VWLhzBY
  • Images :http://imgur.com/a/afLVO
We hope that this can be a sufficient tiebreaker. We are undergoing map testing now and we will update you in this post.
